name: New York makes another NBA title run
thesis: The Knicks win at least 50 games, reach the playoffs, and contend for the East and NBA titles in 2026–27.
summary: New York wins at least 50 games and makes a serious run at the Eastern Conference and NBA titles.
fit: A Prism-selected Knicks season scenario inspired by Alvarado's public Kalshi partnership and team connection.
risk: Win thresholds overlap, and title and best-record outcomes are much less likely than making the playoffs. Quotes and depth can change before an order is placed.

rows.rationale: A 50-win season is the baseline for a strong Knicks campaign.
A 55-win season tests a more dominant regular season.
A playoff berth is the first step in the title-run thesis.
The league's best record expresses the upper end of regular-season strength.
Winning the East is the direct path to the Finals.
An NBA title is the final outcome of the thesis.

name: Milan's domestic and European push
thesis: AC Milan wins near-term fixtures, finishes in Serie A's top four with at least 65 points, and stays in contention for domestic and Europa League titles.
summary: Milan wins key autumn matches, finishes in Serie A's top four, and pushes for league and Europa League titles.
fit: A Prism-selected AC Milan scenario inspired by Kalshi's public Modrić collaboration; AC Milan confirms his contract through June 2027.
risk: The 65-point market is exceptionally thin and priced near $1. The match leg resolves within days, while the season futures run to 2027; execution and timing may differ sharply.

rows.rationale: A top-four finish establishes Milan among the league leaders.
At least 65 league points measures sustained season performance.
A Serie A title is the domestic upside of the thesis.
A Europa League title represents Milan's European upside.
Milan beats Bournemouth in regulation plus stoppage time on October 22, an early European test.

name: LIV's core lineup returns in early 2027
thesis: Bryson DeChambeau and five other established LIV golfers each compete in at least one LIV event during the first quarter of 2027.
summary: Bryson DeChambeau and five other LIV golfers compete in the tour's first quarter of 2027.
fit: A Prism-selected golf participation scenario inspired by DeChambeau's public Kalshi campaign.
risk: Participation contracts depend on each golfer appearing at an event, not on winning. Withdrawals, schedule changes, and thin order books can affect execution.

rows.rationale: DeChambeau's appearance is the anchor of the lineup thesis.
Jon Rahm's appearance broadens the core-player test.
Tyrrell Hatton adds another established player to the participation basket.
Joaquín Niemann's appearance tests continuity of the LIV field.
Cameron Smith adds a fifth player to the returning lineup.
Dustin Johnson rounds out the six-player participation thesis.
